cardData.t62: These little critters usually don't play well with others. For one reason or another, Sam was an exception.
cardData.t30: **ARENA:** Beasties with {BI:"Dingbelle"} in their name or Tokens created by Beasties with {BI:"Dingbelle"} in their name enter the Arena Awakened. / **DESTROYED:** You may activate a Power named **"Mini Sun"** regardless of your **LP** total until the end of the next turn.

effectBlocks.text: Beasties with {BI:"Dingbelle"} in their name or Tokens created by Beasties with {BI:"Dingbelle"} in their name enter the Arena Awakened.
